title: Ankhorage Maps
summary: Provides cross-platform map primitives and explicit web and native adapter boundaries.
purpose: Let applications render and configure maps through a typed package boundary instead of coupling their core UI to one mapping platform.
responsibilities: Define portable map view, marker, camera, coordinate, and styling types.
Expose a map view component and an explicit maps-adapter definition boundary.
Provide platform-specific package entrypoints for web and native map implementations.
boundaries: Does not own application location policy or persistent map data.
Does not choose or configure an application mapping provider.
Does not own application navigation or domain geospatial analysis.
audience: Application authors building web or React Native map experiences.
Adapter authors connecting platform mapping SDKs.
useCases: Render map markers and camera state through the package map-view API.
Supply platform mapping behavior through an explicit maps adapter.

architecture.role: Cross-platform UI library with adapter boundaries for platform mapping implementations.
invariants: Portable map types remain independent of a concrete mapping SDK.
Platform-specific behavior stays at explicit web and native entrypoints.

platforms: Expo when the optional Expo map peer dependencies are installed
limitations: Available map capabilities depend on the selected platform adapter and its host SDK.
The package does not provide location permission or geocoding policy.
